description_en: Queries the basic information about a metatable
description_zh: 该接口用于获取表的基础信息
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public get-meta-table-basic-info --table-guid odps.engine_name.table_name --cluster-id abc --database-name abc --table-name abc --data-source-type emr --extension false --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetMetaTableBasicInfo

parameters.help_en:
The GUID of the MaxCompute table. Specify the GUID in the odps.projectName.tableName format.

This parameter is optional for E-MapReduce (EMR) tables
parameters.help_zh:
MaxCompute表的唯一标识。格式为odps.projectName.tableName。

EMR场景下，该参数非必选
parameters.name: table_guid

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the EMR cluster. This parameter is required only if you set the DataSourceType parameter to emr.

You can log on to the EMR console (https://emr.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.965cc5c2GeiHet#/cn-hangzhou) to query the ID
parameters.help_zh:
EMR集群的ID，当DataSourceType（数据类型）参数配置为EMR时，当前参数必配。

您可以登录EMR的控制台 (https://emr.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.965cc5c2GeiHet#/cn-hangzhou)，获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the metadatabase. This parameter is required only if you set the DataSourceType parameter to emr.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780105.html operation to query the name
parameters.help_zh:
数据库的名称。仅当数据类型为EMR时，需要配置该参数。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780105.html接口获取
parameters.name: database_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the metatable in the EMR cluster. This parameter is required only if you set the DataSourceType parameter to emr.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780086.html operation to query the name
parameters.help_zh:
EMR的表名称。仅当数据类型为EMR时，需要配置该参数。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780086.html接口，获取表名称
parameters.name: table_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the data source. Valid values: odps and emr
parameters.name: data_source_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include extended fields in query results. The extended fields include ReadCount, FavoriteCount, and ViewCount. This parameter takes effect only if you set the DataSourceType parameter to odps
parameters.help_zh:
是否包含扩展字段。
扩展字段包含读取次数、收藏次数、浏览次数等。
仅当数据类型为ODPS时，该参数生效
parameters.name: extension

Caption.description_en: The display name of the metatable

ClusterId.description_en: The ID of the EMR cluster

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the metatable was created
CreateTime.description_zh:
创建表的时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1589870294000`

DataSize.description_en: The size of storage space that is occupied by the metatable. Unit: bytes
DataSize.description_zh: 表占用的存储空间。单位为Byte

EnvType.description_en:
The type of the environment. Valid values:

0: development environment

1: production environment
EnvType.description_zh:
环境类型，取值如下：
0表示开发表。
1表示生产表

FavoriteCount.description_en: The number of times the metatable was added to a favorite list. This parameter is returned only if you set the Extension parameter to true and takes effect only if you set the DataSourceType parameter to odps
FavoriteCount.description_zh: 表的收藏次数。仅当Extension参数取值为true时才会返回该参数，并且该参数仅对odps数据类型生效

IsPartitionTable.description_en:
Indicates whether the metatable is a partitioned table. Valid values:

true

false
IsPartitionTable.description_zh:
是否为分区表，取值如下：
true：是分区表。
false：不是分区表

IsView.description_en:
Indicates whether the metatable is a view. Valid values:

true

false
IsView.description_zh:
是否为视图，取值如下：
true：是视图。
false：不是视图

IsVisible.description_en:
The scope in which the metatable is visible. Valid values:

0: The metatable is visible to workspace members.

1: The metatable is visible to users within the tenant.

2: The metatable is visible to all tenants.

3: The metatable is visible only to the metatable owner
IsVisible.description_zh:
表的可见性：
0表示目标表对工作空间成员可见。
1表示目标表对租户内成员可见。
2表示目标表对租户间成员均可见。
3表示目标表仅对责任人可见

LastAccessTime.description_en: The time when the metatable was last accessed
LastAccessTime.description_zh:
最近一次访问表的时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1589870294000`

LastDdlTime.description_en: The time when the schema of the metatable was last changed
LastDdlTime.description_zh:
最近一次变更表结构的时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1589870294000`

LastModifyTime.description_en: The time when the metatable was last updated
LastModifyTime.description_zh:
最近一次更新表的时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1589870294000`

LifeCycle.description_en:
The lifecycle of the table. Unit: day.

If the lifecycle is not set for a MaxCompute table, the return value is 0, indicating that the table is permanently valid
LifeCycle.description_zh:
表的生命周期。单位为天。
MaxCompute表未设置生命周期时，返回值为0，表示永久有效

Location.description_en: The storage path of the Hive metadatabase

OwnerId.description_en: The ID of the metatable owner

PartitionKeys.description_en: The partition key of the Hive metatable

ReadCount.description_en: The number of times the metatable was read. This parameter is returned only if you set the Extension parameter to true and takes effect only if you set the DataSourceType parameter to odps
ReadCount.description_zh: 表的读取次数。仅当Extension参数取值为true时才会返回该参数，并且该参数仅对odps数据类型生效

Schema.description_en: The schema information of the metatable. This parameter is returned if the three-layer model of MaxCompute is enabled
Schema.description_zh: 表Schema信息。在ODPS，用户启动了三层模型需要填写Schema信息

ViewCount.description_en: The number of times the metatable was viewed. This parameter is returned only if you set the Extension parameter to true and takes effect only if you set the DataSourceType parameter to odps
ViewCount.description_zh: 表的浏览次数。仅当Extension参数取值为true时才会返回该参数，并且该参数仅对odps数据类型生效

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
